subject.title: feat: heading-aware chunking + entity extraction for memory search

question: Should this umbrella issue be split so heading-aware chunking is approved as the first memory-core deliverable while entity extraction and graph-style memory remain under Memory MVP product design?
rationale: The source-visible chunking gap is concrete, but entity extraction and graph memory add product/API direction that automation should not choose from one umbrella issue.

options.title: Split and approve chunking first
options.body: Create or bless a narrow heading-aware chunking task and leave entity/concept/synthesis behavior under the Memory MVP issues.

options.title: Keep as one umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical memory recall improvement tracker and require maintainer review before any implementation PR.

options.title: Route all to Memory MVP
options.body: Supersede this only if maintainers decide the open Memory MVP issues fully own both chunking and entity extraction follow-up.

recommendation.title: Split and approve chunking first
recommendation.body: Create or bless a narrow heading-aware chunking task and leave entity/concept/synthesis behavior under the Memory MVP issues.

likelyOwner.reason: The current chunker and indexing call path are blamed to recent memory-host SDK/memory-core refactor lines under this account, making it the best available routing candidate for the concrete chunking decision.
